1: // Canvas Dodge game implementation
2: // HTML contains <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: (() => {
4:   // Sound setup using Web Audio API
5:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
7:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
8:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
9:     osc.type = 'sine';
10:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
11:     osc.connect(gain);
12:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
13:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
15:     osc.start();
16:     setTimeout(() => {
17:       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05);
18:       osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.06);
19:     }, duration);
20:   }
21: 
22:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
23:   if (!canvas) return;
24:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
25:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
26:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 400;
27: 
28:   // Player
29:   const player = { x: 80, y: height - 30, radius: 15, vy: 0, onGround: true, crouching: false };
30:   const GRAVITY = 0.8, JUMP_VELOCITY = -12, SLIDE_TIME = 300;
31:   let slideTimer = 0;
32: 
33:   // Obstacles
34:   const obstacles = [];
35:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 4, OBSTACLE_INTERVAL = 1500;
36:   let lastObstacle = 0;
37: 
38:   // Score
39:   let startTime = performance.now(), score = 0;
40: 
41:   // Input
42:   const keys = {};
43:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
44:     // Ensure audio context is running after user interaction
45:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
46:     keys[e.code] = true;
47:   });
48:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.code] = false);
49:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => keys['Space'] = true);
50:   canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => keys['Space'] = false);
51: 
52:   function spawnObstacle() {
53:     const size = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
54:     obstacles.push({ x: width, y: height - size, w: size, h: size });
55:   }
56: 
57:   function update(dt) {
58:     // Jump
59:     if ((keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['Space']) && player.onGround) {
60:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
61:       player.onGround = false;
62:       playTone(440, 100); // jump sound
63:     }
64:     // Slide / crouch
65:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] && !player.crouching) {
66:       player.crouching = true;
67:       slideTimer = SLIDE_TIME;
68:       playTone(300, 80); // slide sound
69:     }
70:     if (player.crouching) {
71:       slideTimer -= dt;
72:       if (slideTimer <= 0) player.crouching = false;
73:     }
74:     // Gravity
75:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
76:     player.y += player.vy;
77:     const groundY = height - (player.crouching ? player.radius / 2 : player.radius);
78:     if (player.y >= groundY) { player.y = groundY; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true; }
79: 
80:     // Obstacles
81:     const now = performance.now();
82:     if (now - lastObstacle > OBSTACLE_INTERVAL) { spawnObstacle(); lastObstacle = now; }
83:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
84:       const o = obstacles[i];
85:       o.x -= OBSTACLE_SPEED;
86:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
87:     }
88: 
89:     // Collision (circle-rect)
90:     for (const o of obstacles) {
91:       const nearestX = Math.max(o.x, Math.min(player.x, o.x + o.w));
92:       const nearestY = Math.max(o.y, Math.min(player.y, o.y + o.h));
93:       const dx = player.x - nearestX, dy = player.y - nearestY;
94:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < player.radius * player.radius) {
95:         playTone(150, 200); // collision sound
96:         alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.floor(score));
97:         obstacles.length = 0;
98:         player.x = 80; player.y = height - 30; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true; player.crouching = false;
99:         startTime = performance.now(); score = 0; return;
100:       }
101:     }
102:     // Score
103:     score = (now - startTime) / 1000;
104:   }
105: 
106: function draw() {
107:     // Background gradient
108:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,width,height);
109:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#e0f7fa');

111:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
112:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);

116:     pGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffeb3b');
117:     pGrad.addColorStop(1, '#f44336');
118:     ctx.fillStyle = pGrad;
119:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
120:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
121:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(player.x - player.radius/3, player.y - player.radius/3, player.radius/5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
122:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
123:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(player.x - player.radius/3, player.y - player.radius/3, player.radius/10, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
124: 
125:     // Obstacles as rounded rectangles with gradient
126:     for (const o of obstacles) {
127:         const oGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x+o.w, o.y+o.h);
128:         oGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ff7961');
129:         oGrad.addColorStop(1, '#c62828');
130:         ctx.fillStyle = oGrad;
131:         ctx.beginPath();
132:         ctx.moveTo(o.x+5, o.y);
133:         ctx.lineTo(o.x+o.w-5, o.y);
134:         ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x+o.w, o.y, o.x+o.w, o.y+5);
135:         ctx.lineTo(o.x+o.w, o.y+o.h-5);
136:         ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x+o.w, o.y+o.h, o.x+o.w-5, o.y+o.h);
137:         ctx.lineTo(o.x+5, o.y+o.h);
138:         ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x, o.y+o.h, o.x, o.y+o.h-5);
139:         ctx.lineTo(o.x, o.y+5);
140:         ctx.quadraticCurveTo(o.x, o.y, o.x+5, o.y);
141:         ctx.fill();
142:     }
143: 
144:     // Score
145:     ctx.fillStyle = '#212121';
146:     ctx.font = '18px Arial';
147:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+Math.floor(score),10,30);
148: }

150:   let lastTime = 0;
151:   function loop(ts) {
152:     const dt = ts - lastTime; lastTime = ts;
153:     update(dt);
154:     draw();
155:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
